items.source: Extracts the text content from a Document to be used for embedding. By default, returns Document.getText(). Implementations that support MetadataMode should override this method to return Document.getFormattedContent(org.springframework.ai.document.MetadataMode) with the appropriate metadata mode, so that metadata is included in the text sent to the embedding API.
items.translation: 从 Document 中提取用于嵌入的文本内容。默认情况下，返回 Document.getText()。支持 MetadataMode 的实现应重写此方法，以返回 Document.getFormattedContent(org.springframework.ai.document.MetadataMode) 并传入适当的元数据模式，以便将元数据包含在发送到嵌入 API 的文本中。
